sample_unit: cases (cine cardiac MRI studies) in independent evaluation set

links.outcome: LLM diagnostic accuracy and reproducibility across decoding temperatures and repeated runs
links.effect: V3 accuracy 0.925 stable across temperatures T=0.1, 1.0, 2.0; Fleiss' kappa 0.969 at T=0.1; failure rate 0.83%; V2 0.787-0.800, V1 0.562-0.600.
links.quote: Reproducibility was highest for V3 at T = 0.1 (Fleiss' kappa: 0.969) with a low failure rate (0.83%).

links.outcome: LLM workflow accuracy compared with supervised ML models on same biomarkers
links.effect: LLM V3 accuracy 0.925 comparable to supervised models: Random Forest 0.938; SVM/Logistic Regression 0.925.
links.quote: Performance was comparable to supervised models (Random Forest accuracy 0.938; SVM/Logistic Regression accuracy 0.925).

unlisted_practices: Separating perception (segmentation/biomarker extraction) from LLM reasoning for auditable glass-box diagnosis
Hierarchical veto-logic prompting with majority-vote self-consistency
Radiologist audit of narrative reports for numeric fidelity and clinical safety

screen.reason: The study empirically tests different prompt strategies (including hierarchical veto logic and self-consistency voting) and evaluates their effect on diagnostic accuracy, robustness, numeric fidelity, and safety audits.

primary.practice: prompt strategies and self-consistency voting for auditable diagnosis
